career_ladder.note: Promotional hierarchy for ministerial and subordinate services in the Government of Goa, governed by the Goa Staff Selection Commission Act, 2019, department-specific Recruitment Rules, and Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2016 as adopted by the Government of Goa. Direct recruits at Lower Division Clerk / Junior Assistant (Level 2) progress to Upper Division Clerk (Level 4), Head Clerk / Assistant / Accountant (Level 6), Superintendent Group B Gazetted (Level 7), and Under Secretary / Junior Scale Officer (Level 10) through Departmental Promotion Committees (DPC).

exam_scheme.note: The Goa Staff Selection Commission (GSSC) conducts recruitment to subordinate Group C posts via a Two-Tier Computer Based Examination (CBT) followed by a mandatory qualifying Skill / Typing Test. CBT-I is a common objective screening test (60 marks, 75 minutes) with a mandatory Konkani language passing cutoff of 4 out of 10 marks; candidates who clear CBT-I are shortlisted in a 1:5 ratio for CBT-II. CBT-II is the competitive merit examination (80 marks, 100 minutes) which determines 100% of the selection merit. There is no negative marking in either CBT stage. Candidates passing CBT-II appear for an English typing test (30 wpm) which is strictly qualifying in nature.

papers.notes: Objective MCQs testing English grammar, vocabulary, sentence structure, and comprehension skills. Composite time of 75 minutes for entire CBT-I.
Objective MCQs testing verbal and non-verbal reasoning, analogies, series, pattern recognition, and logical deductions.
Objective MCQs covering basic arithmetic, number systems, percentages, ratios, averages, and time-distance.

Objective MCQs on Konkani language. Mandatory requirement: Candidates must score at least 4 out of 10 marks (questions 1 to 10 in CBT-I) to have the remainder of their paper evaluated. Minimum overall passing for CBT-I is 45% for UR (27/60), 40% for OBC (24/60), and 35% for SC/ST/PwD (21/60). Shortlists 5 times the vacancy count for CBT-II.

stages.source_label: GSSC Advertisement No. 3 of Year 2026 — Syllabus & Scheme of Examination (CBT-II)

papers.notes: Advanced comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, and drafting concepts. Part of the 80-mark composite CBT-II (100 minutes total duration).

papers.paper_name: Test of Basic Knowledge of Computer Proficiency
papers.notes: Computer fundamentals, operating systems, MS Office / word processing, spreadsheets, internet and cyber awareness.

Data handling, arithmetic operations, and quantitative reasoning. Final merit list is constructed strictly on aggregate marks obtained out of 80 in CBT-II. Minimum qualifying: 45% for UR (36/80), 40% for OBC (32/80), 35% for SC/ST/PwD (28/80).

papers.paper_name: English Typing Test (30 wpm on Computer)
papers.notes: Prescribed under Recruitment Rules for LDC / Recovery Clerk / Junior Assistant / Data Entry Operator: minimum typing speed of 30 words per minute in English on computer. Candidates shortlisted in 1:2 ratio based on CBT-II merit; strictly qualifying nature and does not alter CBT-II merit ranking.

financial_package.note: Subordinate clerical staff recruited through GSSC are appointed under the Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 as adopted by the Government of Goa vide Finance Department Order No. 8/1/2016-Fin(R&C). Lower Division Clerks, Junior Assistants, and Recovery Clerks enter at Pay Matrix Level 2 (entry basic ₹19,900), whereas Accounts Clerks enter at Level 4 (entry basic ₹25,500). Allowances include Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% benchmark, House Rent Allowance (10% to 20% based on Goa municipal/rural classification), Transport Allowance (₹1,350 + DA), and state healthcare benefits.
financial_package.pay_source_label: GSSC Advertisement No. 3 of Year 2026 & Government of Goa Adoption of CCS (RP) Rules 2016
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary calculated on entry basic ₹19,900 + 58% DA (₹11,542) + HRA (₹1,990 to ₹3,980 at 10% to 20% in Goa cities/talukas) + Transport Allowance (₹1,350 + 58% DA = ₹2,133). In-hand estimate factors in statutory employee deductions including 10% National Pension System (NPS Basic + DA = ₹3,144), Goa Professional Tax (₹200/mo), and Goa State Employees Group Insurance Scheme (GIS).
official_perks: Comprehensive medical coverage under Goa Government Employees Medical Reimbursement Scheme and Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY)
Pension and social security under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Government of Goa matching contribution
Earned Leave (30 days/yr), Half Pay Leave (20 days/yr), and Casual Leave (8 days/yr)
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and Hostel Subsidy as per Goa Government orders
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) / Home Town Concession as per Central Civil Services norms
Festival Advance, Computer Advance, and House Building Advance (HBA) eligibility under Goa financial rules
